quote: Ergotamine tartrate and caffeine tablets are indicated as therapy to abort or prevent vascular headache; e.g., migraine
note: Migraine appears only on the ergotamine/caffeine combination label (plus unattributed 'treats migraine' fragments); the abortive indication belongs to ergotamine and the caffeine-only butalbital combos cover tension headache, not migraine.

quote: Erosive esophagitis diagnosed by endoscopy.
note: Erosive esophagitis / erosive GERD healing of lesions is a specific form of esophagitis named as the treated condition.

quote: Uses for hand washing to decrease bacteria on the skin.
note: Only antibacterial hand-soap text is supplied; gingivitis, gums or oral use are never mentioned.

quote: Tivicay is indicated in combination with other anti-retroviral medicinal products for the treatment of Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) infected adults, adolescents and children
note: EMA text names treatment of HIV infection directly; combination antiretroviral use still counts.

quote: VYEPTI is indicated for the preventive treatment of migraine in adults.
note: Migraine is explicitly the prevented condition in both FDA and EMA text.

quote: Allergic conjunctivitis due to inhalant allergens and foods
note: Atopic conjunctivitis is a standard synonym for allergic conjunctivitis, which is a listed indication.

quote: Cytarabine Injection in combination with other approved anti-cancer drugs is indicated for remission induction in acute non-lymphocytic leukemia of adults and pediatric patients.
note: Acute non-lymphocytic leukemia is the standard synonym for AML and is indicated on single-ingredient cytarabine labels, independent of the VYXEOS combination.

quote: As a single agent, for the treatment of adult patients with deleterious or suspected deleterious germline BRCA -mutated (g BRCA m) HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer.
note: Edge 'breast cancer' is a near parent of the gBRCAm HER2-negative advanced breast cancer indication, not a whole disease class, so it is TARGET rather than FP4.

quote: Leflunomide is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with: active rheumatoid arthritis as a 'disease-modifying antirheumatic drug' (DMARD); active psoriatic arthritis.
note: EMA text lists active psoriatic arthritis as a treated indication.

quote: Regul Oil Serum indications
note: The supplied text is an empty section header for a cosmetic serum with no indication content; fatigue is not mentioned and nothing can be judged.

quote: treatment of endoscopically diagnosed esophagitis, including erosive and ulcerative esophagitis, and associated heartburn due to GERD
note: Healing GERD esophagitis and its heartburn is management of GERD itself (its lesions and cardinal symptom), not a mere symptom swap, so GERD counts as the treated disease.

quote: CLARINEX-D ® 12 HOUR Extended Release Tablets is indicated for the relief of the nasal and non-nasal symptoms of seasonal allergic rhinitis, including nasal congestion
note: Relief of the symptoms of seasonal allergic rhinitis is management of the disease; the combination label attributes nasal congestion to pseudoephedrine's decongestant role and single-ingredient OTC text covers nasal congestion due to hay fever.

quote: Nitazoxanide tablets (patients 12 years and older) are indicated for the treatment of diarrhea caused by Giardia lamblia or Cryptosporidium parvum
note: Antiprotozoal treatment of Giardia lamblia infection (diarrhea caused by Giardia) is giardiasis; the pathogen, not just a symptom, is targeted.

quote: indicated for the treatment of the signs and symptoms of benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH)
note: Treating the signs and symptoms of BPH is management of BPH; the only negation is for hypertension, not BPH.

quote: Patients receiving remission-induction chemotherapy for acute myelogenous leukemia (AML) or myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS) expected to result in prolonged neutropenia
note: AML names the patient population receiving antifungal prophylaxis; the thing prevented is invasive fungal infection, not AML.

quote: Gastrointestinal absorption is impaired by obstruction, inflammatory disease or its complications, or antineoplastic therapy
note: GI obstruction is a circumstance under which parenteral amino acid nutrition is appropriate, not a condition the product treats.

quote: PHOTOFRIN ® is indicated for the palliation of patients with completely obstructing esophageal cancer, or of patients with partially obstructing esophageal cancer
note: Photodynamic palliation of obstructing esophageal cancer is tumor-directed management of the disease under a dedicated 'Esophageal Cancer' indication heading.

quote: LITFULO is a kinase inhibitor indicated for the treatment of severe alopecia areata in adults and adolescents 12 years and older.
note: Alopecia areata (severe form) is the explicitly treated condition in FDA and EMA text.

quote: In patients with concomitant HIV infection, the physician should be aware of current recommendation of CDC. It is possible these patients may require a longer course of treatment
note: HIV infection is mentioned only as a comorbid population affecting tuberculosis treatment duration; the drug treats tuberculosis.

quote: tinea cruris (ringworm of the groin and thigh)
note: Tinea cruris is dermatophytosis of the groin/perianal region and is a named item in the list of indicated ringworm infections.

quote: refractory anemia with excess blasts in transformation (RAEB-T)
note: RAEB-T is explicitly listed among the indicated FAB MDS subtypes.

quote: RITUXAN, in combination with glucocorticoids, is indicated for the treatment of adult and pediatric patients 2 years of age and older with Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis (GPA)
note: GPA is explicitly the treated disease; combination with glucocorticoids still counts.

quote: Budesonide inhalation suspension is indicated for the maintenance treatment of asthma and as prophylactic therapy in children 12 months to 8 years of age.
note: Single-ingredient budesonide labels indicate maintenance treatment of asthma, so the combination ICS/LABA labels are not needed; the negation covers acute bronchospasm only.

quote: Paclitaxel Injection, USP, in combination with cisplatin, is indicated for the first-line treatment of non-small cell lung cancer
note: NSCLC is directly indicated on single-ingredient paclitaxel and Abraxane labels and in EMA text.

quote: In combination with paclitaxel for first-line treatment of HER2-overexpressing metastatic breast cancer
note: HER2-overexpressing/HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer is explicitly indicated in FDA and EMA text, matching the edge exactly.

quote: Capecitabine tablets USP are indicated for the adjuvant treatment of adults with pancreatic adenocarcinoma as a component of a combination chemotherapy regimen.
note: Pancreatic adenocarcinoma is explicitly the treated disease; adjuvant/combination use still counts.

quote: Bartonellosis due to Bartonella bacilliformis .
note: Bartonellosis appears as an indicated specific bacterial infection fragment in the indications text; it is not in contraindications or warnings.

quote: Kaposi’s sarcoma
note: Kaposi's sarcoma appears as an indication-section fragment for vinblastine, consistent with its palliative-treatment malignancy list; nothing in the text negates it.

quote: Symptoms treated effectively include sneezing, rhinorrhea, postnasal discharge, nasal pruritus, ocular pruritus, and tearing.
note: Every cetirizine-only text lists runny nose, sneezing and itching but omits nasal congestion; congestion appears only in texts with decongestant claims (reduces swelling of nasal passages, sinus congestion and pressure) that belong to a decongestant partner ingredient and cannot be attributed to cetirizine.

quote: Esmolol hydrochloride in sodium chloride injection is also indicated in non-compensatory sinus tachycardia where, in the physician’s judgment, the rapid heart rate requires specific intervention.
note: Non-compensatory sinus tachycardia is a specific form of sinus tachycardia named as the treated condition.

quote: indicated for the temporary relief of coughs and upper respiratory symptoms associated with allergy or the common cold
note: The text relieves cough and upper respiratory symptoms associated with the common cold (and only on combination cough/cold products); the cold itself is not treated, matching the rubric's FP2 example.

quote: severe active anti-neutrophil cytoplasmic autoantibody (ANCA)-associated vasculitis (granulomatosis with polyangiitis [GPA] and microscopic polyangiitis [MPA])
note: GPA is explicitly named as a treated form of ANCA-associated vasculitis; adjunctive use still counts.

quote: temporarily relieves minor aches and pains due to: headache muscle pain toothache menstrual pain colds minor pain of arthritis
note: Toothache is itself a pain condition and is a named item in the list of indicated aches and pains, so relieving it is treating the edge's disease.

quote: indicated for the first-line treatment of adult patients with recurrent, not amenable to surgery or radiotherapy, or metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma.
note: EMA text indicates treatment of nasopharyngeal carcinoma; combination use still counts.

quote: It is indicated for depression accompanied by anxiety or agitation.
note: Anxiety describes the depressed population treated, not the target; the indication is depression, and anxiety otherwise appears only in warnings as an adverse symptom.

quote: Hefiya is indicated for the treatment of active enthesitis-related arthritis in patients, 6 years of age and older
note: Enthesitis-related arthritis is listed under the Juvenile idiopathic arthritis heading as a treated indication, matching enthesitis-related JIA.

quote: is indicated for the treatment of patients with stage III or IV epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer
note: Epithelial ovarian cancer is ovarian carcinoma and is explicitly indicated in FDA and EMA text.
